definitions.gloss: crown prince; heir to the throne
definitions.explanation: The son of an emperor or king who is next in line to inherit the throne. In Japan, this title refers specifically to the heir apparent of the Emperor.

examples.japanese: {皇太子|こうたいし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ご{成婚|せいこん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{皇太子|こうたいし}{殿下|でんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His Imperial Highness the Crown Prince attended the ceremony.

examples.japanese: {皇太子|こうたいし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{即位|そくい}→即位：11974_sokui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧になった。
examples.english: The Crown Prince ascended the throne and became the new Emperor.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, {皇太子|こうたいし} is a formal title with deep cultural significance. The Crown Prince is addressed as {皇太子|こうたいし}{殿下|でんか} (His Imperial Highness the Crown Prince). The female equivalent is {皇太子妃|こうたいしひ} (Crown Princess).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皇太子|こうたいし}{殿下|でんか} (His Imperial Highness the Crown Prince)
- {皇太子妃|こうたいしひ} (Crown Princess)
- {皇太子|こうたいし}ご⟦{夫妻|ふさい}→夫妻：00047_fusai⟧ (the Crown Prince and Princess)
